test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All paintings are calligraphies.

All sketching are calligraphies .

**Conclusions:**

I. At least some calligraphies are paintings.

II. No sketching is a painting.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

All paintings are calligraphies.

All sketching are calligraphies.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17282dfc5a05fcfc0c212cf784d091f19fed801f2eadd7976e8c738e541c73b1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. At least some calligraphies are paintings - True (Because, All paintings are calligraphies, so some calligraphies are paintings).

II. No sketching is a painting - False (Because, No definite relation given between Sketching and Painting, so it can be possible only).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
